author: Ignotus Nemo

positive_cases.timing_note: transiently contended single sample, retained as raw data and excluded from performance comparison

full_history_step.scope_note: The canonical zero-call launch witness was assembled through the complete parent composition. The 16-call witness was satisfaction-checked in the identical fixed direct relation. No terminal proof was frozen.

alignment_study.cause: The eleventh fixed slot moved the six committed selected-region families across a dyadic allocation boundary and introduced 8192 alignment rows. The execution relation itself remained linear.
alignment_study.correction: Keep only deadline-policy values required by the authorization statement before the committed-region allocation. Bind program execution, contexts, recipient and contract-prefix shape after it.

timing_boundary.fixture_preparation: Builds deterministic transactions and authorization proofs for the research fixture. It is not miner block-production latency because users normally supply their authorization proofs.
timing_boundary.matrix_build_and_satisfaction_scan: Builds the direct relation and evaluates every constraint. It is not recursive proof construction.
timing_boundary.interpretation: Structural and adversarial feasibility evidence only. These exploratory timings do not establish latency tails or production throughput.

limitations: No new frozen matrix pack or recursive terminal proof was produced.
The complete parent-verifier composition was assembled and satisfaction-checked for B25. B255 was checked as a complete direct relation.
The instruction set, object receipt and wire ABI remain research inputs rather than a selected consensus interface.
The changed relation has not received a new end-to-end post-quantum soundness calculation.
Admission under invalid-proof load, State-witness availability, stale-proof retries, production proving and network propagation remain unmeasured.
